selection: Sort by numeric system_id; qa_status=pass, years>=2, DC capacity>=10 kW; select first site in each distinct Koppen climate class, stopping at three.
sampling: Apply metadata scale to pre-August raw channels; clip negative auxiliary load to zero, exclude samples above 1.2 times DC nameplate kW; rectangular hourly energy approximation, right-labelled UTC interval ends, rounded median sampling cadence, 75--125% record coverage; do not fill missing hours.
split: First 106 calendar days (before 2018-04-17 UTC) calibration; remaining 106 days test; trailing 30 finite prior same-UTC-hour readings within 45 days.
calibration: EWMA lambda fixed at 0.5 from prior Greek-data study; threshold is per-site 99th percentile of unmodified calibration residuals, never refitted on test
injection: 1% and 5% of finite test readings; seeds 6000..6011; five equal-probability transformations: 50% over-report, 150% over-report, 50% under-report, zero, or low-output collapse; night selections get positive ghost production; unchanged transforms are excluded from positive labels
history: all received readings enter future reference windows (streaming stress test)
outcomes: excess kWh admitted relative to unmodified measured series
monthly batch-equivalent issuance with 1 MWh floor
uncertainty: report each site separately and mean over injection seeds; confidence intervals condition on these fixed sites and periods
scope: Unmodified measured generation is a reference, not verified anomaly-free ground truth. No REC fraud labels, device authentication or statutory registry acceptance are asserted.
qc_amendment_before_any_detector_results: Common end date reduced to the last full month before an August 2018 source schema/unit discontinuity (scale changes at sites 34 and 1239, aggregate-channel disappearance at 1199). No inferred magnitude-based repair is applied.
common_guard: All three policies reject received hourly kWh above 1.2 times site DC capacity kW, before any statistical comparison.
